prompt: Investiga la arquitectura de agentes especializados: qué agentes hay, qué tools tiene cada uno, y cómo se diferencian los locators de los analyzers

assertions.text: Spawns at least 2 sub-agents in parallel (visible as concurrent Task tool calls), not sequentially one after another

Identifies at least 7 of the 9 total agents: codebase-locator, codebase-analyzer, codebase-pattern-finder, thoughts-locator, thoughts-analyzer (core), web-search-researcher (web), research-lead, research-worker, citation-analyst (research)
Lists the specific tools for at least 2 agents (e.g., codebase-locator uses Grep/Glob/LS; codebase-analyzer uses Read/Grep/Glob/LS)
Explains the distinction: locators find WHERE things are (file discovery), analyzers understand HOW things work (implementation details)
